Under the hood / star schema & reproducibility
fact_sales joins dim_date, dim_region and dim_product. SQL generates the same 100,000 rows on each load. This is an in-memory, single-browser OLAP demonstration; changes are lost on refresh. The first load requires access to the jsDelivr CDN.
Filters demonstrate slice and dice; the query menu demonstrates drill-down, roll-up, pivot and ranking. Query times include browser overhead and are not database benchmarks.
